  geom_sf(
    data = tennessee_shapes, 
    aes(fill = AWATER / 1e6),
    color = "white", size = 0.4) +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin") +
  scale_fill_gradient(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(fill = NULL,
       title = "Water Area Distribution Aross Tennessee",

  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
